title: Christie Digital Systems
description:
We’re a global visual technologies company with a vision: helping our customers create brilliant and unforgettable experiences. Customers around the world rely on our solutions to help them do just that in cinema, large mega-events, and themed entertainment. Our technology, paired with the support of professional services to design, deploy and maintain installations, includes advanced RGB pure laser projectors, SDVoE technology, image processing, and LED walls.
